title: Sniper Minion Infernalist Build Guide: Sentry Snipers, Demon Form and Endgame
summary: 0.5.4 Witch summon toolkit: Elemental Sentry as a ranged sniper gives steady single-target, Raging Spirits handle melee, the Infernalist demon form opens a burst window. Covers sentry placement, demon-transform timing and defense boundaries.

sections.title: Build Overview
paragraphs: Sniper Minion Infernalist is the Witch ranged-summon toolkit: Elemental Sentry acts as a placeable sniper giving steady single-target, Raging Spirits handle melee, and the Infernalist demon form opens a burst window when you transform.

The core fun is 'place sentries then kite': most damage is automatic from sentries and spirits; your input is positioning, topping up spirits and triggering the demon form. It does not burn Mana like a pure-caster, but it leans hard on minion survival and minion cap.

This guide is stage-based: first when to move from pure spirits to sentry-led, then gear, passives, demon-form timing and budget tiers. All client numbers and mechanics are flagged for PC verification; unverified DPS is not stated as fact.
bullets: Mapping is spirits on melee + sentry ranged follow-up, near semi-auto.
Bossing closes with sentry sniping plus the demon-form burst.
Minion survival and cap are real bottlenecks that need handling.

sections.title: Pros and Cons
pros: Sentries auto-snipe; mapping is near semi-auto and relaxed.
Demon form gives a clear burst window and clean boss finish.
No Mana cost; sustain pressure is far lower than a pure caster.
Works on a low budget early and transitions smoothly.
cons: Sentry cap and uptime are hard constraints; early output can stall.
Melee enemies bypass sentry range; spirits must cover gaps.
Bosses that move a lot lower sentry hit rate.
Map mods affecting minions (e.g. less minion damage) are a hidden trap.

sections.title: How the Loop Reads: Sentry Place → Spirit Cleanup → Demon Burst
paragraphs: Mapping loop: place Elemental Sentry on the pack's flank; spirits auto-lunge at the nearest enemy while you kite and top up spirits. This is why the community calls it semi-auto mapping.

Boss loop: pre-place one or two sentries along the boss path, use spirits to tank/aggro, then transform into the demon form once its resource is full for the burst window while sentries keep sniping the core.
Phrases like 'sentries aim themselves' usually refer to sentry auto-targeting, not a separate system; verify against the skill description and client, do not treat it as a hidden extra mechanic.
bullets: Mapping = place sentry + kite; spirits handle the rest.
Boss = pre-place sentry → spirits aggro → demon burst.
Spirits are the melee finisher, not the main damage.

steps.label: Levels 1–14
body: Start with Raging Spirit; it is available very early and is your real mapping minion. Do not force sentry count yet — cap and gear are not ready.

steps.label: Levels 15–29
body: Add Elemental Sentry as ranged follow-up and start taking life/spirit-damage/resist nodes. Keep spirits as core.

steps.label: Levels 30–42 — Infernalist Unlocks
body: Pick Infernalist and take demon-form nodes. The transform window now gives boss burst.

steps.label: Levels 43–60 — Early Maps
body: Run sentry + spirits on a non-crit, low budget. Cap resistances, fix life, keep sentries up on rares.

steps.label: Level 60+ — Endgame Prep
body: Move into budget upgrades: sentry cap, minion damage, spirit level and Chaos Res. Only chase high-end gear after the upgrade-priority checklist passes.

skills.role: Placeable ranged sniper giving steady single-target; main boss damage.
whyUse: It is the anchored core of the whole loop; without sentries bossing falls back to unstable pure-spirit pacing.
whenReplace: Never replaced; in maps you can temporarily place fewer to speed up.
mappingBossingDiff: Mapping: one on the flank is enough. Boss: one or two on the path to lock the core.
notes: Exact support links and sentry cap pending PC verification.

skills.role: Melee spirit handling enemies that bypass sentry range and aggroing bosses.
whyUse: It covers the sentry range blind spot; steady for mapping and boss aggro.
whenReplace: Keep permanent; swap only if a stronger melee summon appears.
mappingBossingDiff: Mapping: auto-lunges at mobs. Boss: melee aggro and cleanup.

skills.role: Sacrifices minions for team-wide damage; spikes sentry/spirit output briefly.
whyUse: It is the burst-window damage core; best used with demon form and boss phases.
whenReplace: Keep; part of the damage architecture.
mappingBossingDiff: Used in both, but bossing depends more on its spike.

skills.role: Ground fire wall; projectiles passing through gain fire added, buffing sentries/spirits.
whyUse: Adds fire and area damage, strengthening resolution.
mappingBossingDiff: Mapping optional; bossing placed to empower the window.

skills.role: Casts a spell when a minion dies, adding coverage and self-defense.
whyUse: Auto-adds a layer of damage/control when spirits fall, easing downtime.
whenReplace: Keep; part of the defense architecture.
mappingBossingDiff: Used in both, more critical in bossing.

steps.label: Infernalist — First Nodes
body: Pick Infernalist. Prioritize demon-form nodes so the transform window reliably provides burst; this is the precondition for the build.

steps.label: Minion Survival Check
body: If T15+ minions die often, do not trade demon/damage nodes for pure damage; secure sentry cap and spirit survival first.

steps.label: Campaign
body: Only take nodes supporting spirits/minion damage and life; do not pre-path to sentry-cap wheels.

steps.label: Early Maps
body: Switch into the sentry variant; prioritize life, Chaos Res, minion damage and sentry cap.

steps.label: Endgame
body: After defense and sentry cap are solved, invest in minion crit/damage wheels; compare gear states at the same tier.

recommendations: Pick a base that boosts minion level and spell/minion damage; enough sockets for spirit and sentry links.

sections.title: Mapping
paragraphs: Place Elemental Sentry on the pack's flank; spirits auto-lunge at the nearest enemy while you kite and top up. Trash does not need full sentries; one is enough.
Once clear slows, upgrade the staff first. Keep some survival (resist/life/kite) active so mapping never stalls.
bullets: Place sentry + kite is the whole mapping rhythm.
One sentry is enough for trash.
Reactively upgrade the staff when clear slows.

sections.title: Bossing
paragraphs: Bossing is a sequence: pre-place one or two sentries along the boss path, use spirits to aggro from melee, then transform once the demon resource is full for the burst window while sentries keep sniping the core.
If sentries keep dying, the problem is survival and placement (kite to protect them), not the staff. When the boss moves a lot, place sentries on the narrow path it must cross, not at its feet.
bullets: Pre-place sentry → spirit aggro → demon burst.
Sentry death = fix survival and placement, not swap weapon.

sections.title: Budget Tiers: Real Cheap vs Luxury Differences
paragraphs: Cheap: a low-budget staff plus solved resistances/life/sentry cap, clearing and bossing most content on sentries + spirits. It changes whether you can play, not the damage number.

Luxury: high minion-level Focus, specific Uniques, capped Chaos Res and minion crit, raising both sentry resolution and survival. It changes ceiling and error margin, not turning cheap into a different build.
Mirror tier only after you have verified cheap/luxury pass and client numbers confirm; do not sacrifice Chaos Res and life for DPS.
bullets: Cheap first: life, resistances, sentry cap, a decent staff.
Luxury later: minion level, Chaos Res, crit.
Mirror tier never breaks the defense floor.

items.question: What level do I start using Raging Spirit?
answer: Usable very early; it is the real mapping minion. The sentry toolkit waits for gear and cap.

items.question: I swapped a better staff but sentries are still weak?
answer: Sentries depend on cap and survival, not the staff alone; fix cap and survival first.
bullets: Record a boss fight and check sentry uptime.

items.question: Can I play SSF?
answer: Yes; low-budget sentries + spirits map and boss most content in SSF. Luxury Uniques are a ceiling, not a gate.
